title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
short_description: An open standard for connecting AI models to data sources and tools, streamlining context retrieval for agents.
trend_reason: Rapidly adopted as a standardized protocol for AI agents to securely query external tools and databases.

title: Vector Database Hybrid Search
short_description: Combining dense vector embeddings with traditional sparse keyword search (BM25) for enhanced agentic retrieval accuracy.
trend_reason: Essential architecture pattern for production RAG and AI agent memory systems needing both semantic and exact-match capabilities.

title: Distributed Consensus via Raft
short_description: A consensus algorithm designed as an alternative to Paxos, widely used in distributed state machine replication.
trend_reason: Core foundational protocol for modern cloud-native storage engines, coordination services, and distributed agent state stores.

title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Frameworks
short_description: Architectural patterns for managing state, communication loops, and handoffs between specialized autonomous AI agents.
trend_reason: Transitioning from single LLM prompts to complex distributed agentic workflows requires robust orchestration patterns.

title: Event-Driven CQRS with Kafka
short_description: Command Query Responsibility Segregation implemented over distributed event logs for high-throughput microservices.
trend_reason: Critical architectural pattern for scaling complex backend systems and maintaining decoupled read/write models.
